scientific_integrity: Exact stationary two-time theorem for the explicitly defined linear two-coordinate diffusion with Poisson resetting of the probe only. Existing one-time moment formula attributed to Santra and Das. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: One harmonic bath coordinate and independent thermal Brownian noises
Instantaneous Poisson reset to zero of probe alone
Fixed-positive-lag fast-reset limit does not include zero lag
Implicit coverage by general linear jump-process formulas remains a scholarly originality risk
title: Two-time bath-memory spectrum and a persistent Green–Kubo excess under probe-only resetting
